# Heatmap

```{r}
## -------------------------------
## 1) Read and prepare datasets
## -------------------------------

# Original contrast labels as they appear in the CSV files
part1 <- c("C_vs_E", "C_vs_RE", "C_vs_R", "E_vs_R", "E_vs_RE", "R_vs_RE")

# Folders for each dataset
ds <- list(
  "L-540 cryo" = "/proj/proteomics/7_combinedHL/evaluation_paper/abc_2025/raw_log2FCdata/hl540_cryo/",
  "L-540 liv"  = "/proj/proteomics/7_combinedHL/evaluation_paper/abc_2025/raw_log2FCdata/hl540_le/",
  "L-428"      = "/proj/proteomics/7_combinedHL/evaluation_paper/abc_2025/raw_log2FCdata/hl428_all/"
)

# Helper: read all CSVs in one folder and merge
read_one_set <- function(label, path){
  files <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  dl <- lapply(files, read.csv)
  names(dl) <- part1[seq_along(dl)]
  
  d <- dplyr::bind_rows(dl, .id = "treatment")
  
  d |>
    dplyr::filter(Gene.name %in% proteins_of_interest) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dataset   = label,
      treatment = factor(treatment, levels = part1)
    )
}

# Read all datasets and combine
final_df <- purrr::map2(names(ds), ds, read_one_set) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

## -------------------------------
## 1b) Relabel contrasts & flip logFC direction
## -------------------------------

# Mapping: old -> new contrast names
map_treat <- c(
  "C_vs_E"  = "E_vs_C",
  "C_vs_RE" = "RE_vs_C",
  "C_vs_R"  = "R_vs_C"
)

final_df$treatment <- as.character(final_df$treatment)

# Rows that need to be flipped and relabeled
idx <- final_df$treatment %in% names(map_treat)

# 1) Relabel treatment
final_df$treatment[idx] <- map_treat[ final_df$treatment[idx] ]

# 2) Flip logFC sign for these contrasts
final_df$logFC[idx] <- final_df$logFC[idx] * -1

# Desired contrast order (now in the new direction)
treat_levels <- c("E_vs_C", "RE_vs_C", "R_vs_C", "E_vs_R", "E_vs_RE", "R_vs_RE")

# Define column IDs and display labels
final_df <- final_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    treatment   = factor(treatment, levels = treat_levels),
    col_id      = paste0(dataset, " | ", treatment),
    col_display = as.character(treatment)
  )

# Limit logFC range to [-4, 4]
final_df$logFC[!is.na(final_df$logFC) & final_df$logFC >  4] <-  4
final_df$logFC[!is.na(final_df$logFC) & final_df$logFC < -4] <- -4

## -------------------------------
## 2) logFC matrix & significance matrix
## -------------------------------

# logFC matrix
mat_fc <- final_df |>
  dplyr::select(Gene.name, col_id, logFC, dataset, treatment, col_display) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::arrange(dataset, treatment) |>
  dplyr::select(Gene.name, col_id, logFC) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col_id, values_from = logFC) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene.name") |>
  as.matrix()

mat_fc[is.na(mat_fc)] <- 0

# Significance matrix (symbols)
mat_sig <- final_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Significant = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.P.Val < 0.001 ~ "\u2731\u2731\u2731",
      adj.P.Val < 0.01  ~ "\u2731\u2731",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05  ~ "\u2731",
      adj.P.Val < 0.1   ~ ".",
      TRUE              ~ " "
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Gene.name, col_id, Significant, dataset, treatment) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::arrange(dataset, treatment) |>
  dplyr::select(Gene.name, col_id, Significant) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col_id, values_from = Significant) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene.name") |>
  as.matrix()

mat_sig[is.na(mat_sig)] <- " "

# Column annotation (datasets, treatments, display label)
annot_col <- final_df |>
  dplyr::distinct(col_id, dataset, treatment, col_display) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dataset, treatment) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("col_id")

## -------------------------------
## 3) Row annotation: functional categories
## -------------------------------

gene2cat <- c(
  # -------------------------
  # DNA Damage, Chromatin Remodeling & Nuclear-Envelope Stress
  # -------------------------
  "APEX1"   = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "ARMT1"   = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "BANF1"   = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "BCCIP"   = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "BCLAF1"  = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "DDB1"    = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "EEF1E1"  = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "FEN1"    = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "GAR1"    = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "PARP1"   = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
  "SMARCC2" = "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",

  # -------------------------
  # Mitochondrial Dysfunction & Energy Collapse
  # -------------------------
  "CYC1"   = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "DLST"   = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "NENF"   = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "OGDH"   = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "OXCT1"  = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "SDHA"   = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "SDHB"   = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "SOD2"   = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "SUCLG1" = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "SUCLG2" = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "SLC4A7" = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "VDAC1"  = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "VDAC2"  = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
  "VDAC3"  = "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",

  # -------------------------
  # Protein Misfolding, ER Stress & Proteostasis
  # -------------------------
  "BAG6"      = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "CDC37"     = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "CDC42"     = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "MANF"      = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "MYDGF"     = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "NUDC"      = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "PDCD6"     = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "PDCD6IP"   = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "PCYT1A"    = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "SERPINB6"  = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
  "ST13"      = "Protein misfolding & ER stress",

  # -------------------------
  # Metabolic & Stress Signaling Regulation
  # -------------------------
  "GRB2"   = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "HK1"    = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "HK2"    = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "KCNAB2" = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "NFKB1"  = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "NUDT5"  = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "NUP214" = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "OGFR"   = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "PURA"   = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "RBM4"   = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "STAT1"  = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "STAT3"  = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "STAT5A" = "Metabolic & stress signaling",
  "STAT6"  = "Metabolic & stress signaling",

  # -------------------------
  # Apoptosis
  # -------------------------
  "ACIN1"   = "Apoptosis",
  "AIFM1"   = "Apoptosis",
  "API5"    = "Apoptosis",
  "CASP3"   = "Apoptosis",
  "CCAR1"   = "Apoptosis",
  "CCAR2"   = "Apoptosis",
  "EPS15L1" = "Apoptosis",
  "PDCD4"   = "Apoptosis",
  "PDCD5"   = "Apoptosis",
  "PRCP"    = "Apoptosis",
  "TNFAIP8" = "Apoptosis",

  # -------------------------
  # Other / assigned to more than one group
  # -------------------------
  "LGALS1"  = "Other / assigned to more than one group",
  "LGALS3"  = "Other / assigned to more than one group",
  "TNFRSF8" = "Other / assigned to more than one group",

  # -------------------------
  # Immune Modulation & Surface Remodeling
  # (nur die, die eindeutig in dieser Kategorie bleiben sollen)
  # -------------------------
  "CD63"    = "Immune modulation & surface remodeling",
  "CD70"    = "Immune modulation & surface remodeling",
  "HDGF"    = "Immune modulation & surface remodeling"
)

## -------------------------------
## 3b) Build annotation_row from gene2cat
## -------------------------------

# all genes in the matrix
all_genes <- rownames(mat_fc)

# category vector from gene2cat (NA für Gene, die nicht in gene2cat stehen)
row_cat <- gene2cat[all_genes]

# nur Gene behalten, die eine Kategorie haben
keep <- !is.na(row_cat)

mat_fc   <- mat_fc[keep, , drop = FALSE]
mat_sig  <- mat_sig[keep, , drop = FALSE]
row_cat  <- row_cat[keep]
all_genes <- rownames(mat_fc)

# factor with levels matching gene2cat category strings
annotation_row <- data.frame(
  Category = factor(
    row_cat,
    levels = c(
      "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress",
      "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse",
      "Protein misfolding & ER stress",
      "Metabolic & stress signaling",
      "Apoptosis",
      "Immune modulation & surface remodeling",
      "Other / assigned to more than one group"
    )
  ),
  row.names = all_genes
)

# sort matrix and annotation by category, then gene name
ord <- order(annotation_row$Category, rownames(mat_fc))
mat_fc         <- mat_fc[ord, , drop = FALSE]
mat_sig        <- mat_sig[ord, , drop = FALSE]
annotation_row <- annotation_row[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# automatic row gaps at category boundaries
cat_vec  <- as.character(annotation_row$Category)
gaps_row <- which(head(cat_vec, -1) != tail(cat_vec, -1))

## -------------------------------
## 4) Colors, gaps & pheatmap calls
## -------------------------------

# Color scale for logFC
rng    <- 4
breaks <- seq(-rng, rng, length.out = 101)
col_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(length(breaks))

# Column gaps between datasets
# (Assumes 3 datasets x 6 contrasts = 18 columns -> gaps after 6 and 12)
col_gaps <- c(6, 12)

# Annotation colors (must match Category strings above)
anno_cols <- list(
  dataset = c(
    "L-540 cryo" = "#D9D9D9",
    "L-540 liv"  = "#D9D9D9",
    "L-428"      = "#D9D9D9"
  ),
  Category = c(
    "DNA damage / chromatin / NE stress"            = "#8DD3C7",
    "Mitochondrial dysfunction & energy collapse"   = "#FFFFB3",
    "Protein misfolding & ER stress"                = "#BEBADA",
    "Metabolic & stress signaling"                  = "#FB8072",
    "Apoptosis"                                     = "#80B1D3",
    "Immune modulation & surface remodeling"        = "#FDB462",
    "Other / assigned to more than one group"       = "#CCCCCC"
  )
)

# Heatmap with legend
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat_fc,
  color = col_palette,
  breaks = breaks,
  border_color = NA,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = mat_sig,
  number_color = "#00000080",
  fontsize_number = 3,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  labels_col = annot_col$col_display,
  annotation_col  = annot_col[, c("dataset"), drop = FALSE],
  annotation_row  = annotation_row,
  annotation_colors = anno_cols,
  annotation_legend = TRUE,
  annotation_names_col = TRUE,
  gaps_col = col_gaps,
  gaps_row = gaps_row,
  fontsize_row = 4.65,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  cellheight = 3.75,
  cellwidth  = 12,
  fontsize   = 6
)

# Heatmap without legend
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat_fc,
  color = col_palette,
  breaks = breaks,
  border_color = NA,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = mat_sig,
  number_color = "#00000080",
  fontsize_number = 3,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  labels_col = annot_col$col_display,
  annotation_col  = annot_col[, c("dataset"), drop = FALSE],
  annotation_row  = annotation_row,
  annotation_colors = anno_cols,
  annotation_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_names_col = TRUE,
  gaps_col = col_gaps,
  gaps_row = gaps_row,
  fontsize_row = 4.65,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  cellheight = 3.75,
  cellwidth  = 12,
  fontsize   = 6
)
```
